summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all requirements: unit tests for semantic version logic (parsing, classification, bumping, changelog rendering), structural validation of workflow YAML, and end-to-end testing via act with 6 matrix test cases covering feat/fix/breaking/mixed/package-json/no-bump scenarios. All major code paths exercised. Strengths: well-organized into logical layers (unit/structural/integration), parametrized tests, exact value assertions in act output, session-scoped fixture efficiency. Minor gaps: error paths (file not found, malformed JSON, permission issues) tested primarily at integration level not unit level; limited boundary condition testing (e.g., very large version numbers, special characters in scopes); some edge cases like multiple breaking changes not explicitly covered. Per task design, file I/O testing is intentionally deferred to act workflow rather than unit tests.
